color.follow_ha.card: Each calendar's colour in Home Assistant, where it holds one
color.custom.description: Any colour the card can draw: #e91e63, a CSS name, or a theme variable
color.invalid: Not a colour the card can draw
color.kept: Kept until the text above is a colour
entity.color.helper: Event titles from this calendar. Overrides the card colour.
entity.accent_color_mode.helper: Home Assistant can hold a colour for each calendar, under Settings, Devices & Services, Entities. Calendars it has no colour for fall back to the card.
entity.label_icon_color.helper: Left empty, the icon takes the text colour around it.
entity.event_type.helper: List the same calendar twice — once on each of the last two — to give its all-day and timed events different colours.
time_grid.weekend_background_color.helpe: Tints a weekend day column from just under the date row down, so a week reads at a glance. Any CSS colour — keep it faint, since event text sits on top of it. Which days count as the weekend follows the country set in Home Assistant, or its language when no country is set.
time_grid.today_background_color.helper: Tints today's column from just under the date row down, so today stands out at a glance. Off until a colour is set. Any CSS colour — keep it faint, since event text sits on top of it. When today falls on the weekend, it replaces the weekend shading.
filter_duplicates_mode.helper: Hides an event that matches another on the fields chosen here. The copy from the entry listed first is the one kept, along with its colour. Leaving location out suits a holiday that two regional calendars each carry under their own location.
duplicate_accent_color.helper: Accent colour for an event kept from two or more different calendars, in place of the first calendar’s. Left empty it keeps that calendar’s colour.
title.helper: Text containing {{ or {% is a Home Assistant template and updates by itself. With the toolbar shown, the title's size and colour apply to the month.
accent_event_text: Use Calendar Colours For Event Text
accent_event_text.helper: Draws each event’s title, time, location, description and progress bar in the colour of the calendar it came from, rather than in one colour for the whole card. Grid does this by default. Each of those five options also takes the value accent on its own, so one field can follow the calendar while the rest do not — and switching this off returns all five to their standard colours rather than to anything set before.
today_weekday_color.helper: Left empty, each of today's colours falls back to its weekend equivalent on a weekend, and then to its usual one.
today_day_color.helper: Left empty, the digits on the date tile take a deeper shade of the tile's colour.
accent_color_mode.helper: Home Assistant can hold a colour for each calendar, under Settings, Devices & Services, Entities. Calendars it has no colour for keep the card default.
accent_color_mode.option.custom.label: Custom colour
event_background_opacity.helper: Tints each event with its accent colour. Zero leaves it untinted.
allday_badge_position.helper: Marks all-day events with a rounded badge in the calendar accent colour. On the time row it replaces the all-day label; on the title it wraps the event name. A title badge is kept to one line and shortened with an ellipsis where it does not fit.
allday_badge_style.helper: How much weight the badge carries, from a quiet wash to a solid block of colour.
allday_badge_color_mode.helper: Which colour the badge is drawn in. The accent gives every calendar its own; the row text colour gives them all the colour they already sit in, which is the time colour on the time row and the title colour on the title.
now_color.helper: The colour of an event that is happening right now, and of the now line in grid view.
